evals.name: modernizes-a-legacy-skill
evals.prompt: The file legacy-SKILL.md in this directory is a skill we wrote for an older model generation. Modernize it for the current one. Save the rewritten skill as SKILL.md in this directory.

assertions.text: The rewrite passes the body lint
The self-verification and depth-by-prose instructions are gone
assertions.check: ! grep -qiE 'double.?check|be thorough|take your time|re-?verify|think step by step' SKILL.md

assertions.text: The description names concrete contexts or phrasings that should route to the skill, rather than a bare summary like 'Writes PR descriptions.'
The rewrite still covers the original job of producing a PR description from a diff

evals.name: captures-a-workflow-as-a-skill
evals.prompt: Every time someone on our team adds a database migration I have to remind them to check it drops no column without a backfill step, and to confirm it has a matching rollback. I am tired of repeating myself. Turn this into something Claude does on its own. Save whatever files you create in this directory.

assertions.text: The description names migration vocabulary a user would actually type
The body encodes both rules from the request: no column drop without a backfill, and a matching rollback
The body states goals and constraints rather than reciting a rigid numbered script for work whose order is not load-bearing
